# Soil Probes

## Overview
This page compiles research and forum findings regarding capacitive soil probe corrosion, longevity, and [hardware](./hardware.md) options for agricultural and home lab [sensors](./sensors.md) deployments.

## Key Details
- **Failure Rates:** Inexpensive soil probes typically fail within 6 to 9 months when deployed in acidic soil environments due to [sensor corrosion](./sensor-corrosion.md).
- **[SenseNode SN-400](./sensenode-sn-400.md):** Features a coated probe design to mitigate corrosion issues. Replacements are available for $12.
- **[Aurora Beta Probe](./aurora-labs.md):** Utilizes a gold-flashed printed circuit board (PCB), though long-term durability testing remains untested.
